pages.title: Power Starts Here
pages.text: The Electrician's Desk is where the power system begins: generators, batteries, Tesla Coils, charging posts, AC/DC converters, the industrial fermenter — almost every electric device is "assembled" right here.$(br2)Right-click to open the interface. It has nine slots: the six on the left hold the ingredients ($(l)the order must be right$()), paper and ink go top-right, and the finished item appears on the far right.

The desk itself is crafted at a crafting table. Laying out the materials is not the same as finishing the craft — click the lit button on the right and it first spends 1 paper and 1 ink, then starts a mini-game.

pages.title: Two Steps to Craft
pages.text: Once the mini-game is cleared the button lights up again, and only $(l)one more click$() actually consumes the ingredients and produces the item. In other words, every craft costs 1 paper + 1 ink and one cleared mini-game.$(br2)The ingredient order must follow exactly what EMI or REI shows.

pages.title: Do Not Walk Away
pages.text: Mini-game progress lives on the client only: once you close the interface, or step more than 7 blocks away from the desk, that round is void and the paper and ink are not refunded.$(br2)Only one player can use a desk at a time.

Slide the tiles with WASD or the on-screen buttons; equal numbers merge into a bigger number, and the goal is the number shown in the target field.$(br2)Each craft randomly picks one of four mini-games; when 2048 comes up the goal is usually 64, 128 or 256.

pages.title: Circuit Replica
pages.text: Click the '?' button to see a blue target pattern, then rebuild the circuit board from the green starting board to match it: click to rotate a component, use the tools to remove or move them, press Space to switch to move mode, and press R to reset.$(br2)Some recipes ask for one board, others ask for three boards in a row.

pages.title: Tower of Hanoi
pages.text: Move every disc from the left peg to the right peg; a shorter disc can only rest on a longer one. Press Enter at any time to finish.$(br2)The number of discs is set by the recipe, usually 3 to 6: six discs take at least 63 moves.

pages.title: Prepare the Parts First
pages.text: Most electric devices need three kinds of "component" as intermediate parts: $(item)Redstone Component$(), $(item)Silicon Component$() and $(item)Diamond Component$(), four per craft.$(br2)The redstone component is the common part of every electric kitchen appliance (electric steamer, ice cream maker, electric whisk, juice extractor, advanced furnace), so make a batch of them. Silicon ingots are made by smelting quartz in a blast furnace.
